title.value: Continuous-Time Meta-Learning with Forward Mode Differentiation
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly stated at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: C ONTINUOUS -T IME M ETA -L EARNING WITH F ORWARD M ODE D IFFERENTIATION

analysis.description: This paper introduces Continuous-Time Meta-Learning (COMLN), a meta-learning algorithm where adaptation follows the dynamics of a gradient vector field. The algorithm treats learning as an ordinary differential equation (ODE) and optimizes the meta-parameters using stochastic gradient descent, with the forward mode differentiation technique employed to compute the exact meta-gradients efficiently in constant memory. COMLN is shown to be effective for few-shot image classification problems.

type.justification: The paper provides empirical results showing the efficiency and effectiveness of COMLN in image classification tasks, alongside analytical guarantees for the stability of the method.
type.quote: We provide analytical guarantees for the stability of COMLN, we show empirically its efficiency in terms of runtime and memory usage, and we illustrate its effectiveness on a range of few-shot image classification problems.
